# GEONI

> GEONI is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform that measures and improves how brands, people and websites appear in AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity). It combines a self-service scanning product at app.geoni.ai with expert-delivered visibility services.

GEONI, markaların, kişilerin ve web sitelerinin yapay zeka cevap motorlarındaki (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) görünürlüğünü ölçen ve iyileştiren bir Üretken Motor Optimizasyonu (GEO) platformudur.

## Product (app.geoni.ai)

- **AI Visibility Scan (Web):** Crawls a website, checks AI crawler access (robots.txt rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and others), llms.txt presence, structured data (JSON-LD schema) coverage, and queries live AI engines to produce a 0-100 AI Visibility Score with a prioritized gap list.
- **Person / Brand Check:** Asks the same questions a real user would ask across 4 AI engines in parallel and reports whether the person or brand is recognized, how it is described, and which competitors appear instead.
- **Watchlist & Score Tracking:** Re-scan targets over time; score history, deltas and trends per target.
- **Token model:** Pay-as-you-go tokens, no subscription required; tokens never expire.

## AI Visibility Services (expert-delivered, ordered inside the app)

- **AI Bot Access Setup:** robots.txt + llms.txt files generated for the customer's domain (automated, delivered in minutes).
- **Structured Data (Schema) Setup:** Organization / Person / Product / FAQ JSON-LD authored for the site and verified with Google Rich Results Test.
- **Entity Registration:** Creating or enriching the brand/person entity record in global knowledge bases with independent sources.
- **AI-Citable Content Production:** Answer-first content engineered to be quoted by AI engines.
- **Trusted Source Visibility:** Earned mentions via journalist/media outreach channels and niche directories.

Each service ships with a work-breakdown checklist, in-app messaging with the assigned expert, and a delivery report.

## Managed Packages

- **Visibility Audit (one-time):** Baseline scans, competitor comparison, prompt-simulation map across 15-20 real buyer questions, prioritized action list, live presentation.
- **Citation Builder (monthly):** Technical GEO infrastructure - bot access, schema, entity consistency - kept live, plus 2-4 AI-ready contents per month.
- **AI Authority (monthly):** Citation Builder plus media citations, entity record management, monthly prompt-simulation maps and strategy sessions.
- **Enterprise (custom):** Multi-brand management with a dedicated strategist, API/dashboard integration and white-label reporting.

## Facts

- Scoring dimensions include: AI crawler accessibility, structured data coverage, entity presence (knowledge graphs), brand recall inside LLMs, and citation footprint.
- GEONI distinguishes training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot) from search/citation crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot) - visibility in real-time AI answers is governed by the latter.
- Market: Türkiye-based (Ankara), serving globally. Interface in Turkish and English.
